_help: Copy this file to goals.json and edit. The checklist ticks itself from Garmin + calendar data.
metric: activity_count | activity_hours | activity_km   (Garmin activities; filters: sport, name_contains, min_minutes)
calendar_hours | calendar_count                  (calendar blocks that have ended; filters: category, title_contains)
sleep_nights (min_hours, min_score) | step_days (min_steps) | manual (tick it yourself)
category: training | work | study | reading | personal | other
sport: run | ride | swim | strength | other, or a list like ["run", "ride"]
mode: at_least (default) or at_most, e.g. a weekly running-km cap
